findings_addressed.oracle: The conftest.py module-level importorskip was already removed (wave context confirms this). The test file itself never imported intellicrack_hexcore. Tests now run unconditionally as pure-Python gates. Weak existence-only assertions were hardened: conditional branch tests now assert raw_bytes and display_value from known data bytes; struct-array test now verifies element offsets and byte values via struct.unpack_from as independent oracle; bool-cast tests now assert concrete offset/raw_bytes/display_value; struct-sequential-fields test now verifies child offsets and display_value strings derived via struct.unpack_from.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/core/hexpat/evaluator.py, change the if/else branch evaluation to always evaluate the if-branch regardless of condition truth (e.g., replace 'if condition:' with 'if True:' in _eval_conditional_field).
